jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

3KSVpamW84ZvYJgvlVQ6dw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情嚴峻,該省近1週新增2,892例病例,以佛山市最多(2,770例),其次為廣州市(65例),疫情分布地區擴大,惠州市亦出現病例;佛山市截至7/31累計逾6,900例病例,該省其他城市近期亦出現病例,並於澳門及香港等地出現移入病例,澳門近日已報告2例本土病例。
3KSVpamW84ZvYJgvlVQ6dw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak: 2,892 new cases were reported in the past week, mainly in Foshan City (2,770), followed by Guangzhou City (65). The affected area has expanded, and Huizhou City has also reported cases. As of 31 July, Foshan City had cumulatively reported more than 6,900 cases. Other cities in the province have also recently reported cases, and imported cases have appeared in Macao and Hong Kong. Macao has recently reported two local cases.

S41ZImifjp1CEh1QJYLP-Q.zh: 澳門今年新增報告2例本土病例,工作地點皆為新城A區,案1為34歲男性,於7/27出現咽喉痛,經檢驗陰性,8/1上肢及胸部出現皮疹,經檢驗確診;案2為34歲女性,於7/30四肢出現紅疹,8/1出現臉部出疹及發燒就醫,2日經檢驗確診,病患住院隔離中,病情穩定,病患曾於7/13-21至日本旅遊,期間未被蚊蟲叮咬,7/22-29(除7/27週休)返澳後皆至新城A區工作,當局近日接獲中國通報多名居住於珠海並於該區工作之確定病例,考量病患之旅遊史、發病時間及檢驗結果,均列為本土病例;今年截至8/2累計6例境外移入及2例本土病例,已啟動防控小組,加強積水和孳生源巡查等防治工作。 香港於8/2報告今年首例境外移入病例,為12歲男童,於7/31出現發燒、皮疹及關節痛至診所就醫,8/1轉介住院並經實驗室確診,病況穩定;病患曾於7/17-30至廣東省佛山市旅遊,自述曾被蚊蟲叮咬,接觸者迄無症狀。香港於2016-19每年通報1-11例境外移入病例,當局已啟動調查及病媒蚊防治工作,另呼籲民眾倘曾至蚊媒傳染病風險地區,應於14日內持續使用防蚊液,倘有發燒、關節痛或皮疹等症狀,應立即就醫。中國廣東省佛山衞生局截至7/31通報逾6,900名病例,病患主要來自於順德區(5,972例)。
S41ZImifjp1CEh1QJYLP-Q.en:
Macao reported two new local cases this year. Both patients work in New City Zone A (新城A區). Case 1 is a 34-year-old man who developed a sore throat on 27 July, with a negative test result; he developed a rash on the upper limbs and chest on 1 August and was confirmed by testing. Case 2 is a 34-year-old woman who developed a red rash on her limbs on 30 July, then facial rash and fever on 1 August, sought care, and was confirmed by testing on 2 August. She is hospitalized in isolation, and her condition is stable. The patient travelled to Japan from 13 to 21 July, reported no mosquito bites during the trip, and after returning to Macao on 22–29 July (excluding the 27 July rest day) worked at New City Zone A every day. Authorities recently received notification from China of several confirmed cases living in Zhuhai and working in the same area; given the patient's travel history, onset timing and test results, both cases have been classified as local. As of 2 August this year, six imported and two local cases had been cumulatively reported. A prevention and control team has been activated, with stronger inspection of standing water and breeding sources.
Hong Kong reported its first imported case of the year on 2 August: a 12-year-old boy who developed fever, rash and joint pain on 31 July and visited a clinic. He was referred to hospital on 1 August, confirmed by laboratory testing, and his condition is stable. The patient had travelled to Foshan City, Guangdong, from 17 to 30 July and reported being bitten by mosquitoes; none of his contacts has shown symptoms. Hong Kong reported 1–11 imported cases annually in 2016–19. Authorities have launched an investigation and vector control work, and urge people who have visited mosquito-borne disease risk areas to keep using mosquito repellent for 14 days, and to seek medical care immediately if they develop fever, joint pain or rash. The Foshan Municipal Health Commission reported more than 6,900 cases as of 31 July, mainly from Shunde District (5,972 cases).

4vrpLk6Moei-p3ZWbwHmSw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情嚴峻,截至7/26累計逾4,800例病例,均為輕症,尚無重症及死亡病例,近1週(7/20-26)新增2,940例,以佛山市最多(2,882例),其次為廣州市(22例)及中山市(18例),並於澳門等地出現移入病例。
4vrpLk6Moei-p3ZWbwHmSw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak. As of 26 July, more than 4,800 cumulative cases have been reported, all mild, with no severe or fatal cases. In the past week (20–26 July), 2,940 new cases were reported, most of them in Foshan City (2,882), followed by Guangzhou (22) and Zhongshan (18). Imported cases have also appeared in areas including Macao.

OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/16本土病例累計30例,境外移入病例累計799例,當局表示過去疫情集中於南部地區,現已傳播至原本無疫情地區,包括東北部之大東部大區(Grand Est)以及西南部之新阿基坦大區(Nouvelle-Aquitaine),另警告本土傳播風險仍高,預期病例數持續上升。 中國廣東省佛山市自7/8報告首例境外移入後,截至7/19已累計1,199例病例,均為輕症病例,分布於佛山市順德區、南海區及禪城區。澳門7/18報告該地區今年首例,病患為61歲男性澳門居民,7/8-17前往佛山市順德區探親,17日早上出現發燒、頭痛及全身肌肉關節痛症狀,18日確診,已住院治療,同居者迄無症狀。
OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.en: France has updated its situation. As of 16 July this year, 30 locally acquired cases and 799 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities said past outbreaks were concentrated in the south but have now spread to areas that previously had no cases, including the Grand Est region in the northeast and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in the southwest. They warn that the risk of local transmission remains high and that case numbers are expected to keep rising. In Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China, 1,199 cumulative cases had been reported as of 19 July since the first imported case was reported on 8 July. All were mild and distributed across Shunde, Nanhai and Chancheng districts. Macao reported its first case of the year on 18 July: a 61-year-old male resident who visited relatives in Shunde District, Foshan, from 8 to 17 July. He developed fever, headache and generalized muscle and joint pain on the morning of 17 July, was diagnosed on 18 July, and has been hospitalized. His household contacts have shown no symptoms so far.

mQ39fZkpMiRInkDUpoctoQ.zh: 澳門近期猩紅熱疫情上升,10月初單週報告5例病例,11月底已升至單週22例,今年截至12/3累計報告1,654例,以1至9歲兒童居多,其中54例(3.3%)住院,無人死亡,當局呼籲家長及教育機構提高警覺。
mQ39fZkpMiRInkDUpoctoQ.en: Scarlet fever cases have been rising in Macao SAR recently. Weekly reported cases were 5 in early October and rose to 22 by late November. As of 3 December this year, a cumulative 1,654 cases have been reported, mostly children aged 1 to 9. Of these, 54 (3.3%) were hospitalized, and there were no deaths. Authorities urge parents and educational institutions to stay alert.
